CodeGraph operationalises selected security/compliance concerns as Rego policies. The evaluated crypto/hash/randomness families use direct ISO A.10-style mappings, while the injection and path-query families are pragmatic OWASP Benchmark CWE mappings into the secure-development control area. The benchmark therefore validates pattern-level detection for those families rather than full standards-compliance fidelity.
notes: The evaluated injection/path families are pragmatic benchmark mappings, not direct ISO clauses.

claim_text_safe_for_thesis: FAISS/vector search is used as evidence enrichment for LLM-facing explanation and remediation prompts. It is not part of the Rego detection decision path in the reported benchmark evaluation, and this thesis does not claim a separate detection improvement from FAISS.
notes: No FAISS-off detection ablation artifact exists.
